Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

Addressed to both parties. This is a rider-filed route-deviation dispute over trip TRP-02837 and the SGD 19.32 charged fare, and the rider's claim is not upheld. NO_ACTION: the fare stands and no refund issues. The rider's arithmetic is right on its own terms — the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02837) records 13.2 km against the 10.0 km optimal stored at booking (EV-TRIP-02837), an excess of 3.2 km / 32.0% that clears both POL-RD-01 establishment gates, and the trace governs over the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km. The trace is clean (104 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0), so POL-RD-07 does not impair it and POL-RD-10(3) does not fire. The claim fails because the booking baseline moved. POL-RD-05 applies: the trip_record shows the drop-off amended after booking, dropoff_amended_at 2026-08-16T17:04:12, and carries the stored amended_optimal_distance_km of 13.4 km (amended_optimal_duration_min 18.5). The chat log (EV-CHAT-02837) corroborates it — the rider wrote at 17:03:32 'actually can you drop me at the other building, i changed the pin' — and the driver's statement says the same. POL-RD-05 requires the threshold test to be re-run against the amended endpoints on that stored re-quote, and bars the Judge from deriving a substitute figure. Re-run: 13.2 - 13.4 = -0.2 km. No deviation survives the recomputation, and POL-RD-05 directs NO_ACTION. The rider's answer — that both pins carry the label 'Blk 112 Ang Mo Kio Ave 4' and this was therefore a pin refinement rather than a relocation — is rejected: the amended pin is a different coordinate (1.3295, 103.871 against the original 1.3267, 103.8733), the platform recorded the amendment and produced a stored re-quote, and the clause keys on the recorded amendment, not on the label. The driver's separate POL-RD-04 point is also answered: the rider's message names no place and chat_message.waypoint_hint is null, so the 200 m corroboration test cannot be run and POL-RD-04 excludes nothing; the excess is removed by POL-RD-05 instead. Remaining points, answered together: POL-RD-03 is unavailable and no party asserted an external traffic cause — the missing advisory EV-ADVIS-02837-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT, issued by a party citing no advisory covering this trip) is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation, and it carries no fact. POL-RD-06 is not engaged: there is no MATERIAL deviation (3.2 km / 32% is under both material gates) and no trail under the clause's citable counters (deviation_flags_90d = 1; 1/237 = 0.004), the driver profile's other fields being context only under POL-GEN-01, so no conduct referral arises. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-02837) carries no phantom gantry or surcharge line, so POL-RD-09 gives no correction; the trip identifiers and the trace's first and last fixes match the trip_record across the board, so POL-RD-10(2) and (4) do not fire, and no refund approaches the ceiling. Figures used: trace distance 13.2 km (EV-GPS-02837); booked optimal 10.0 km and amended optimal 13.4 km (EV-TRIP-02837); charged total SGD 19.32 (EV-FARE-02837). Confidence 0.9, above the 0.70 floor. This is a provisional ruling; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

How to appeal: POL-GEN-04. Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 0.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Addressed to both parties. This is a rider-filed route-deviation dispute over trip TRP-02837 and the SGD 19.32 charged fare, and the rider's claim is not upheld. NO_ACTION: the fare stands and no refund issues. The rider's arithmetic is right on its own terms — the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02837) records 13.2 km against the 10.0 km optimal stored at booking (EV-TRIP-02837), an excess of 3.2 km / 32.0% that clears both POL-RD-01 establishment gates, and the trace governs over the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km. The trace is clean (104 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0), so POL-RD-07 does not impair it and POL-RD-10(3) does not fire. The claim fails because the booking baseline moved. POL-RD-05 applies: the trip_record shows the drop-off amended after booking, dropoff_amended_at 2026-08-16T17:04:12, and carries the stored amended_optimal_distance_km of 13.4 km (amended_optimal_duration_min 18.5). The chat log (EV-CHAT-02837) corroborates it — the rider wrote at 17:03:32 'actually can you drop me at the other building, i changed the pin' — and the driver's statement says the same. POL-RD-05 requires the threshold test to be re-run against the amended endpoints on that stored re-quote, and bars the Judge from deriving a substitute figure. Re-run: 13.2 - 13.4 = -0.2 km. No deviation survives the recomputation, and POL-RD-05 directs NO_ACTION. The rider's answer — that both pins carry the label 'Blk 112 Ang Mo Kio Ave 4' and this was therefore a pin refinement rather than a relocation — is rejected: the amended pin is a different coordinate (1.3295, 103.871 against the original 1.3267, 103.8733), the platform recorded the amendment and produced a stored re-quote, and the clause keys on the recorded amendment, not on the label. The driver's separate POL-RD-04 point is also answered: the rider's message names no place and chat_message.waypoint_hint is null, so the 200 m corroboration test cannot be run and POL-RD-04 excludes nothing; the excess is removed by POL-RD-05 instead. Remaining points, answered together: POL-RD-03 is unavailable and no party asserted an external traffic cause — the missing advisory EV-ADVIS-02837-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT, issued by a party citing no advisory covering this trip) is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation, and it carries no fact. POL-RD-06 is not engaged: there is no MATERIAL deviation (3.2 km / 32% is under both material gates) and no trail under the clause's citable counters (deviation_flags_90d = 1; 1/237 = 0.004), the driver profile's other fields being context only under POL-GEN-01, so no conduct referral arises. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-02837) carries no phantom gantry or surcharge line, so POL-RD-09 gives no correction; the trip identifiers and the trace's first and last fixes match the trip_record across the board, so POL-RD-10(2) and (4) do not fire, and no refund approaches the ceiling. Figures used: trace distance 13.2 km (EV-GPS-02837); booked optimal 10.0 km and amended optimal 13.4 km (EV-TRIP-02837); charged total SGD 19.32 (EV-FARE-02837). Confidence 0.9, above the 0.70 floor. This is a provisional ruling; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
This ruling is addressed to both parties. In short: the rider changed the drop-off point during the trip, so the longer distance travelled is the distance the rider asked for, and the claim is not supported. The SGD 19.32 already charged stands and the SGD 4.50 disputed is not returned. WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. On 16 Aug 2026 the rider booked Blk 55 Lengkok Bahru to Blk 112 Ang Mo Kio Ave 4 (EV-TRIP-02837). The platform's booking-time route estimate (optimal_distance_km) was 10.0 km. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02837: 104 fixes, 10 s interval, 100% coverage, empty gaps) measures the distance driven at 13.2 km, and the fare ledger (EV-FARE-02837) bills the same 13.2 km for a charged_total of 19.32. On the booked baseline the excess would be 3.2 km / 32%, which would clear the POL-RD-01 gates (0.8 km and 20%). WHY THE BOOKED BASELINE IS NOT THE GOVERNING ONE. The trip_record shows the drop-off point was amended after booking: dropoff_amended_at is 2026-08-16T17:04:12, and the stored re-quote amended_optimal_distance_km of 13.4 km (duration 18.5 min) sits with it. The rider's own in-app message at 17:03:32 (EV-CHAT-02837) reads 'actually can you drop me at the other building, i changed the pin'. POL-RD-05 therefore applies and directs the POL-RD-01 test to be re-run against the optimal route between the amended endpoints. POL-RD-05 makes that a stored field that must be used and not re-derived, and it is present, so no substitute figure is invented and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. Re-run: actual 13.2 km (the trace governs over the rounded trip_record copy) minus amended optimal 13.4 km = -0.2 km. The driver drove slightly less than the platform's own amended optimal. No deviation survives the recomputation, and POL-RD-05 provides that the outcome is then NO_ACTION. THE RIDER'S ARGUMENTS, ANSWERED. (a) The rider argues the pin was only 'refined' inside the same building label, so the driver must prove a relocation explains the excess. I reject this: POL-RD-05 keys on the trip_record showing the drop-off amended after booking, which it does, and the rider's own message says they changed the pin to 'the other building'. The clause does not require the label to change, and it was the rider who asked for the change. (b) The rider's establishment claim (3.2 km / 32% on the booked baseline) is correct as far as it goes but is displaced by POL-RD-05. (c) The rider's POL-RD-02 arithmetic (charged 19.32 less recomputed 16.02 = 3.30) is correct as arithmetic, but POL-RD-02 only runs where a deviation is established and no exculpatory clause fully excuses it. POL-RD-05 excuses it, so the 3.30 is never reached. (d) I accept that POL-RD-04 is unavailable here: the message names no road or place and chat_message.waypoint_hint is null, so the 200 m corroboration test cannot be run. That does not help the rider, because POL-RD-05 is a separate clause and applies on the trip_record alone. (e) I accept the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c) (max_gap_sec 0.0, 10 s sampling, no jumps), so no POL-RD-10(3) corroboration is required. OTHER CHECKS. No POL-RD-06 pattern arises: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 (below 3) and 1/237 completed_trips_90d = 0.004 (below 0.05), and no MATERIAL deviation is recorded, so there is no conduct referral and no FULL_REFUND uplift. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02837-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; I name it and it changes nothing, because neither party asserts an external traffic cause and no advisory is invoked under POL-RD-03, so this is a gap in the bundle, not a contradictory invocation. The fare ledger carries no ERP, toll or airport-surcharge line, so there is no phantom charge to correct under POL-RD-09(4) and no POL-RD-10(8) escalation. Trip identifiers (TRP-02837) and timestamps agree across EV-TRIP-02837, EV-GPS-02837 and EV-FARE-02837, so POL-RD-10(2) and (4) do not fire, and no other POL-RD-10 trigger is met. The fare is METERED (quoted_fare_sgd null), so POL-RD-11 does not apply. OUTCOME. Under POL-GEN-03 the ruling is NO_ACTION: fare_breakdown.payment_status stays CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd stays 0.00. No refund and no driver compensation is due, and there is no clause-mandated referral. Confidence 0.90, capped by the weight 1.0 of the artifacts carrying the deciding facts (EV-TRIP-02837 and EV-GPS-02837, with EV-CHAT-02837 at 1.0 corroborating the amendment). The monetary effect is nil, below the POL-GEN-05 threshold. This is a provisional ruling; either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04.
To the rider and the driver: the ruling is NO_ACTION. The SGD 19.32 fare stands and nothing is refunded. Why. On this trip the drop-off point was changed after booking. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02837, weight 1.0) shows dropoff_amended_at at 17:04:12, i.e. during the trip, and stores the re-quoted route to that amended point as 13.4 km (trip_record.amended_optimal_distance_km). The rider's own in-app message at 17:03:32 (EV-CHAT-02837, weight 1.0) — 'actually can you drop me at the other building, i changed the pin' — and the moved pin coordinates (about 400 m from the original pin) confirm the change. To both parties: this is the route-deviation dispute over trip TRP-02837, on which the rider was charged SGD 19.32. What the evidence shows. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02837, weight 1.0, COMPLETE — 104 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, empty gaps array) records the distance driven as 13.2 km. The route estimate stored at booking was 10.0 km, and that is the figure the rider's complaint measures against; on that comparison the excess is 3.2 km / 32.0%, which clears both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (over 20% and over 0.8 km). The rider is right that the trace figure governs over the rounded trip_record copy. Why that comparison is not the one that decides the case. The trip record shows the drop-off point was amended after booking: trip_record.dropoff_amended_at is 2026-08-16T17:04:12, and the record carries the platform's re-quoted optimal for the amended destination, amended_optimal_distance_km = 13.4 km, with amended_optimal_duration_min = 18.5. POL-RD-05 therefore requires the threshold test to be re-run against the AMENDED endpoints, and it requires the stored 13.4 km figure to be used — the policy expressly forbids me to re-derive a substitute. Re-run: 13.2 km (trace) less 13.4 km (amended optimal) = minus 0.2 km. No excess survives; the driver drove slightly less than the platform's own optimal route to the amended destination. POL-RD-05 states that where no deviation survives the recomputation, the outcome is NO_ACTION. The rider's POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 claims (deviation established at 3.2 km; refund of 19.32 - 16.02 = 3.30) are rejected for that reason, and no ERP or surcharge line needs correcting, so POL-RD-09(4) produces nothing. The rider's message and why POL-RD-04 does not rescue the rider. The chat log's single message, sent 17:03:32, reads 'actually can you drop me at the other building, i changed the pin', and chat_message.waypoint_hint is null. The message names no road or actable place, and with no waypoint coordinate the 200 m corroboration test cannot be run, so POL-RD-04 exonerates nothing (and POL-RD-14, on an uncorroborated instruction, reaches the same non-result). The amendment itself is dealt with under POL-RD-05, which does not depend on a waypoint hint. The rider's argument that the message is too vague to ground an exoneration is accepted, but it does not undo the recorded pin change. The 'same label' point. I accept the observation that both the original pin ('Blk 112 Ang Mo Kio Ave 4 (original pin)') and the amended pin ('Blk 112 Ang Mo Kio Ave 4') carry the same building name, and that a pin move of roughly 0.4 km sits oddly beside a re-quote 3.4 km longer than the booked optimal. But POL-RD-05 is triggered by the record showing the drop-off was amended after booking and it directs me to the stored amended optimal; it gives me no licence to fall back to the 10.0 km booked figure or to invent a different re-quote on the strength of the labels. I have noted the point as an open question below. Trace integrity. Limbs (a) to (c) of POL-RD-07 do not fire: max_gap_sec is 0.0 with no gaps, the sampling interval is 10.0 seconds (well under the 30-second ceiling) and there are no straight-line jumps above 500 m. The pre-pass rates the trace COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so no confidence cap attaches under POL-GEN-02 and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02837-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; neither party asserts an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the absence neither exonerates the driver nor escalates the case (POL-RD-13). Other checks. No repeat-deviation pattern: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 (below 3) and 1 divided by completed_trips_90d of 237 is 0.004 (below 0.05), so POL-RD-06 gives no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral; the excess (32.0%) is in any case below both materiality gates (50% and 8.0 km). The trip identifiers all read TRP-02837 and the timestamps (first fix and started_at 17:00:12; last fix and ended_at 17:17:22) agree to the second, so no POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires. No clause produces a referral on these facts. Outcome. NO_ACTION. The claim is not supported by the evidence and the present state stands: fare_breakdown.payment_status remains CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd remains 0.00, so the SGD 19.32 fare stays in place. The monetary effect is SGD 0.00, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05. Open question for the human reviewer (this is not a referral): the amended re-quote of 13.4 km is 3.4 km longer than the booked 10.0 km optimal for what the two drop-off labels suggest is a small pin move. The policy did not permit me to re-derive that figure; if the platform's routing engine produced it in error, the rider's underlying complaint about a 3.2 km excess may deserve a second look.
